_doc: Revert-verify for ems__Bug 96a86732 (ExoSync body merge resurrected a section deleted on one side when the other side renamed its heading, and kept text twice when the two sides put different headings over shared text), subject = StructuredMerger.ts, output invariant textCountViolation in mergeBody. Axes T*/C*/P* in StructuredMerger.text-invariant.test.ts, H* in StructuredMerger.heading-rename.test.ts (run together so a mutant that breaks a 1fdfd7fb control shows up). Not locked by any mutant here, regression controls of the merger: T2/T4/T9 (conflicted before through other guards; T9 is now held by the invariant too), C2/C3 (every base paragraph there has m = min(l, r) or 0, so no non-negative bound reddens them). P1/P2 are the named price (a move cannot be told from a delete + identical re-add). Named gap, asserted by no axis in either direction: text changed inside a paragraph (a renamed section whose only paragraph was also edited, a dense list split by different headings). Run: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this spec> after setting tree and subject to YOUR checkout.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/sync/StructuredMerger.ts

M2_no_unchanged_side_clause.from: unique && l === b ? r : unique && r === b ? l : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);

M3_no_independent_additions.from: unique && l === b ? r : unique && r === b ? l : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);
M3_no_independent_additions.to: unique && l === b ? r : unique && r === b ? l : Math.max(l, r);

M4_own_side_bound.from: unique && l === b ? r : unique && r === b ? l : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);
M4_own_side_bound.to: unique && l === b ? l : unique && r === b ? r : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);

M5_mirror_clause_off.from: unique && l === b ? r : unique && r === b ? l : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);
M5_mirror_clause_off.to: unique && l === b ? r : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);

M7_untrimmed._note: An untrimmed unit keeps the leading newline of the blank line under its heading and the trailing newline / \r / spaces, so its string depends on the paragraph's POSITION in the section: once a paragraph moves under another heading it no longer matches its base copy and the invariant loses it. Reddens every axis where a paragraph changes position (T5, T12-T14, P1) or carries whitespace/CRLF separators (T15-T17).

M10_new_text_judged._note: The rejected alternative 'judge text new on both sides for duplication too' (planning §7).

M11_split_on_bare_newlines_only._note: The plan's split: whitespace-only blank lines and CRLF bodies no longer divide paragraphs (review MEDIUM-1).

M13_repeated_not_judged._note: Also locks 'l + r' and 'l + r - 1' in place of 'l + r - b' (review W1/W2): T12 reddens them, but their set equals this one, so they stay out of the spec.

M14_one_side_none_means_none.from: unique && l === b ? r : unique && r === b ? l : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);
M14_one_side_none_means_none.to: unique && Math.min(l, r) === 0 && Math.max(l, r) >= 1 ? 0 : Math.max(l, r, l + r - b);

M16_newlines_only_trimmed._note: Strips newlines but keeps spaces and \r: T15 (trailing spaces), T16 (whitespace-only blank lines leave a leading space), T17 (CRLF leaves \r).
